_comment: How the proof drives a link, as chatd IPC requests (what the window sends). `legacy` is today's
flow: the new device shows a tiny-device-... code and the old one sends tiny_e2ee approve{code};
it links but moves no history. `v1` is the device-link flow, with the request names the client
branch feat/device-link uses (crates/protocol/src/e2ee.rs E2eeAsk::Link*, as of 2026-11-05,
uncommitted there). If they change, change only this file. Templates: {account} {code} {check}
{history} are filled in. mode: auto = v1 when the server advertises e2ee_device_link, else legacy.
